gemini.rationale: The E&P assets (T4) and their direct operational processes (T5) were transferred together, resulting in no gap_45. However, WPX lacked the administrative personnel and processes (T6) to operate independently at closing, relying on Williams for functions like IT, HR, and accounting, which constitutes a gap_56. This structural mismatch was mitigated at closing by a transition services agreement.

grok.rationale: At closing the E&P customer-facing asset base (proved reserves, basin production, Apco interest) was contributed to WPX together with the dedicated operating workforce (1,073 FTEs transferring effective 1 Jan 2012) and the business assets/liabilities, so the product and its producing processes crossed together (gap_45=0). Processes that did transfer were accompanied by the people and management who ran them (employee transfer plus employee-matters agreement); the administrative functions retained at Williams were never transferred ownership of process or org but were only interim-accessed under the transition services agreement, yielding no process-without-org mismatch at closing (gap_56=0).

openai.rationale: The E&P asset base and associated liabilities transferred to WPX, but WPX remained dependent on Williams for numerous administrative processes, so the customer-facing business crossed without the full process substrate, creating a gap_45. That mismatch was contractually absorbed through a transition services agreement commencing on the distribution date. For gap_56, the dedicated workforce was scheduled to transfer to WPX effective January 1, 2012, while the retained shared processes continued to be performed by Williams under the transition arrangement; the slice therefore does not document processes transferring without an aligned organization.
